end.text:
In Standard English you should only have one negative in a sentence. Having a double negative is an example of non-Standard English.

“I didn’t tell nobody” is wrong.
“I didn’t tell anybody” is right.
'Ain't' is another common example of non-Standard English. We should always replace it with 'have not', 'do not', or 'am not'.

instruction.text: Drag and match the non-Standard English sentences to their Standard English equivalents.

atoms.sound: I shouldn’t ever have done that.

atoms.a: He wasn’t nowhere to be seen.
atoms.sound: He was nowhere to be seen.
